articles.summary: Companies join forces to help professional builders work smarter, build faster, and deliver a better homeowner experience. Builders FirstSource, Inc. (NYSE: BLDR), a leading provider of building materials and value-added services, and Digs, a leading AI platform for homebuilders and homeowners, today announced a strategic partnership to deliver the next generation of AI-powered workflows and digital infrastructure for professional builders and homeowners. Under the partnership, Builders FirstSource is the solo lead on Digs’ $25.3 million Series A financing and has also entered into a five-year commercial agreement with Digs to accelerate product development, strengthen platform integration, and expand AI capabilities. articles.title: Builders FirstSource and Digs Announce Strategic Partnership to Deliver the Next Generation of AI-Powered Homebuilding
